item.title: Serve
item.author: test@example.com (Web Author)
item.description:
Service to Our Community

At New Birth of Believers Ministry, we believe that the Gospel is not only something we proclaim—it is something we live. As followers of Christ, we are called to love, serve, encourage, and make a positive difference in the lives of those around us.

Jesus said:

“By this everyone will know that you are my disciples, if you love one another.” — John 13:35

Our desire is to be a church that reaches beyond its walls and serves our community with compassion, humility, and the love of Christ. We believe that every believer has a role to play, and that our time, talents, resources, and spiritual gifts can be used to bless others and bring glory to God.

item.title: Speak
item.author: test@example.com (Web Author)
item.description:
Speak

Resources and notes about biblical teaching, encouragement, spiritual growth, and pastoral care.

Our desire is to speak the truth of God’s Word with love, bringing encouragement, hope, and guidance to individuals as they grow in their relationship with Christ.

Groups

Our ministry groups provide opportunities for fellowship, service, encouragement, and the development of the gifts God has given each believer.

EMIT STAR

Women Empowerment

A community dedicated to encouraging and empowering women to discover their God-given identity, gifts, purpose, and potential. EMIT STAR provides a supportive environment where women can grow spiritually, encourage one another, and become a positive influence in their families, church, and community.
